name: Flashpoint 2035
description: A fictional near future, New Year 2035: a crowded multipolar world on edge. Warships shadow each other in the Taiwan Strait, the melting Arctic and a newly independent Greenland draw rival suitors, nuclear-armed India and Pakistan quarrel over Kashmir and the Indus, tankers run a gauntlet at Hormuz, and drought on the Nile meets a war for the Red Sea coast.
approximations: Fictional scenario extrapolated from the Modern World (2026). Borders are the 2026 ones except that Greenland has become independent (an invented outcome). Population and GDP are 2026 figures times rough growth multipliers; armies, navies, air forces, nuclear stockpiles and military satellites are plausible extrapolations, not forecasts. The Ethiopia-Eritrea war, the rivalries, the Sahel and AUKUS blocs as defence pacts and all events are invented. Frontier economies start with the first speculative technologies (quantum computing, directed-energy weapons, vertical farming); the rest of the world is a step behind.
